next_step: Complete Dedicated POC sizing + pricing call w/ CTO (schedule week of Mar 15)
notes:
Summary: mid-market analytics SaaS building a semantic layer for product insights. Currently piloting embeddings/semantic search. Prefer Redwood Hosted for fast spin-up; plan to move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation once scale is validated.

Key quotes: "Need sub-150ms median vector similarity for UI search at 99th percentile of 1k qps spikes" — CTO.

Requirements (from product/infra):
- Embedding batch jobs: nightly refresh for full corpus (~10M records), incremental hourly updates (~1-2k records/hour).
- Vector DB integration: primary eval with Pinecone + Qdrant self-hosted for cost comparison. Need connector story and SDK examples.
- Throughput target: ~500 qps steady, tolerate bursts to 1k qps for 30s.
- Latency target for similarity queries: median <80ms, p99 <200ms.
- Cost sensitivity: unit-cost per embed & per-similarity query matters; team ran local FAISS test with heavy ops cost.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), SOC2 compliance, with audit logs and optional KMS for keys. Data residency: US-only for now.

Engagement history: Hosted API smoke tests used for embedding quality compare (OpenAI + open models). Redwood hosted embeddings performed well on recall + latency in small sample. Now focused on throughput/cost of serving at scale and autoscaling/pricing for Dedicated.
